title: A Multi-Resolution Multi-Domain Pre-Training Framework for Universal Traffic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.13878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatio-temporal traffic data are central to intelligent transportation systems, yet their heterogeneity poses significant challenges for large-scale modeling. Existing pre-trained models often rely on a homogeneous modeling paradigm to handle highly heterogeneous traffic data. This fundamental mismatch not only limits model generalization but also leads to computationally expensive and parameter-inefficient designs. To this end, we propose FlexST, a novel pre-training framework that introduces modularity and adaptivity for traffic modeling. Specifically, we first propose a multi-resolution spatio-temporal diffusion module that captures both short-term fluctuations and long-range trends, effectively reconciling inputs with divergent temporal and spatial resolutions. translated_title: 一种用于通用交通预测的多分辨率多域预训练框架
translated_abstract: 时空交通数据是智能交通系统的核心，但其异质性给大规模建模带来了重大挑战。现有的预训练模型通常依赖同质化的建模范式来处理高度异构的交通数据。这种根本性的不匹配不仅限制了模型的泛化能力，还导致了计算开销高昂且参数效率低下的设计。为此，我们提出了FlexST，一种新颖的预训练框架，为交通建模引入了模块化与自适应性。具体而言，我们首先提出了一种多分辨率时空扩散模块，能够同时捕捉短期波动和长期趋势，有效协调具有不同时空分辨率的输入。随后，我们构建了一种域自适应的混合专家模型，将数据动态路由到专门的子网络，在实现选择性知识迁移的同时防止……
tldr: 提出了FlexST预训练框架，通过多分辨率时空扩散模块和域自适应混合专家机制，有效解决异构时空交通数据建模难题，实现通用交通预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes FlexST, a pre-training framework that combines a multi-resolution spatio-temporal diffusion module with a domain-adaptive mixture-of-experts to enable universal traffic forecasting on heterogeneous data.
